column.value: Privacy policy for Dhanunjaiah Handlooms. How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

insert.column:
Information We Collect

When you use dhanunjaiah.com, we may collect the following information:

  • Account Information: Name, email address, phone number when you register
  • Order Information: Shipping address, payment details (processed securely by Razorpay), order history
  • Usage Data: Pages visited, products viewed, device information, IP address

How We Use Your Information

  • Process and deliver your orders
  • Send order confirmations, shipping updates, and delivery notifications
  • Provide customer support
  • Improve our website and product offerings
  • Send promotional emails (only with your consent — you can unsubscribe anytime)

Payment Security

All payments are processed securely through Razorpay. We do not store your credit card, debit card, or UPI details on our servers. Razorpay is PCI-DSS compliant and uses bank-grade encryption.

Data Sharing

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share data only with:

  • Payment processor (Razorpay) for processing transactions
  • Shipping partners for order delivery
  • Email service for transactional emails

Cookies

We use essential cookies to maintain your login session and shopping cart. We may use analytics cookies (Google Analytics) to understand website usage. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.

Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures including:

  • HTTPS encryption on all pages
  • Secure httpOnly cookies for authentication
  • Passwords stored with BCrypt hashing
  • HMAC signature verification for payments

Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal data
  • Correct inaccurate information
  • Request deletion of your account and data
  • Opt out of promotional communications

To exercise these rights, contact us at ch.dhanunjaiah@gmail.com.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with the updated date.

insert.column:

  • Product images are as accurate as possible, but colors may vary slightly due to monitor settings and photography lighting.
  • Product availability is subject to stock. We reserve the right to limit quantities.

Pricing

  • All prices are in Indian Rupees (INR) and include applicable GST
  • Prices are subject to change without prior notice
  • The price at the time of order placement will be the final price

Orders

  • An order is confirmed only after successful payment
  • We reserve the right to cancel an order if the product is out of stock, payment verification fails, or we suspect fraudulent activity
  • In case of cancellation by us, a full refund will be issued

Payment

  • We accept payments via Razorpay (Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI, Net Banking, Wallets)
  • All transactions are secured with industry-standard encryption
  • Payment must be completed within 30 minutes of order creation, after which the order will be automatically cancelled

User Accounts

  • You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials
  • You must provide accurate and complete information during registration
  • We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms

Intellectual Property

All content on this website — including product images, descriptions, logos, and design — is the property of Dhanunjaiah Handlooms and protected by copyright laws. You may not reproduce, distribute, or use any content without written permission.

Limitation of Liability

Dhanunjaiah Handlooms shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our website or products, except as required by applicable Indian law.

Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Nalgonda, Telangana.

column.name: meta_description
column.value: Shipping information for Dhanunjaiah Handlooms. Free shipping on orders above ₹999. We ship across India.

insert.column:
Delivery Across India

We deliver to all serviceable pin codes across India. Our sarees are carefully packed to ensure they reach you in perfect condition.

Shipping Charges

  • Free Shipping on orders above ₹999
  • ₹99 flat rate for orders below ₹999

Processing Time

Orders are processed within 1-2 business days. You will receive a confirmation email once your order is dispatched with tracking details.

Delivery Time

  • Metro cities: 3-5 business days
  • Other cities: 5-7 business days
  • Remote areas: 7-10 business days

Tracking Your Order

Once shipped, you will receive a tracking number via email and SMS. You can also track your order on our Track Order page using your order number.

Packaging

Each saree is carefully folded with tissue paper and packed in a branded box to preserve the fabric quality during transit.

International Shipping

We currently ship only within India. For international orders, please contact us at ch.dhanunjaiah@gmail.com for custom shipping arrangements.

Contact Us

For any shipping-related queries, reach us at:

  • Phone: +91 94402 49456
  • Email: ch.dhanunjaiah@gmail.com

column.name: meta_description
column.value: Return and refund policy for Dhanunjaiah Handlooms. 7-day return window for handwoven sarees.

insert.column:
Return Window

We accept returns within 7 days of delivery. The item must be unused, unwashed, and in its original packaging with all tags intact.

Eligible for Return

  • Product received is damaged or defective
  • Wrong product delivered
  • Product significantly different from the description or images

Not Eligible for Return

  • Product has been used, washed, or altered
  • Tags or packaging removed
  • Return requested after 7 days of delivery
  • Minor color variations due to monitor settings (handwoven products may have slight variations which are a mark of authenticity)

How to Initiate a Return

  1. Contact us within 7 days of delivery at ch.dhanunjaiah@gmail.com or call +91 94402 49456
  2. Share your order number and reason for return
  3. Our team will review and confirm the return
  4. We will arrange a pickup or provide a return shipping label

Refund Process

  • Refunds are initiated within 3-5 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item
  • Refund will be credited to the original payment method
  • Bank processing may take an additional 5-7 business days

Exchange

We currently do not offer direct exchanges. Please return the item and place a new order for the desired product.

Damaged in Transit

If your saree arrives damaged, please share photos of the damaged package and product within 24 hours of delivery. We will arrange a replacement or full refund at no extra cost.

Contact Us

For return-related queries:

  • Phone: +91 94402 49456
  • Email: ch.dhanunjaiah@gmail.com
